verdict.rationale: The only volume-control evidence is community-reported. Users say default APM log collection can be switched off with agent env vars (NEW_RELIC_APPLICATION_LOGGING_ENABLED/FORWARDING_ENABLED=false) or in the Data Management Hub 'log settings'. Another user reports that filtering out irrelevant metrics and logs was very hard. This is a coarse on/off control, not deliberate sampling or tiering. missing for 10: first-party docs on trace sampling configuration, log sampling or drop/filter rules, configurable retention tiers, granular volume controls beyond disabling log forwarding, and independent corroboration that these controls work well.
